jobs.title: 발키리의 문
jobs.note: v1의 과한 흰 구름과 주변 섬을 줄이고, 낮은 구름 수평선에 황금 날개 문을 배치한 보완안.
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. EDIT reference 1 into stage_card_02-v3, one opaque 16:9 painted pixel-art landscape at largest available resolution. Reference 1 is the image to revise. References 2 and 3 are game style anchors, reference 4 the Asgard palette/landmarks. Preserve the clearly sculpted feather-wing GOLDEN GATE, the castle behind and the falling light columns, and preserve this crisp pixel-cluster rendering. Correct the shared set composition and excessive brightness: lower the cloud-sea horizon to 74% image height; remove ALL of the tall peripheral floating islands, replacing them with a quiet wide blue-grey cloud sea and at most two small silhouettes below y70%. Show the entire central wing gate and castle together within x30-70%, their base at y76%, tallest spire at y24%, no enormous foreground bridge. Use a low short causeway only in bottom quarter. The upper-left light must stay clear, but change almost-white clouds into midtone slate blue / muted lilac and change white stone into pale muted GOLD, so overall exposure is medium, comparable to a twilight fantasy set. Warm highlights confined to gate edges and the three falling light pillars, no broad white blowout. Outer 8px calmer. Remove ALL flags, banners, dials, medallions, letters, glyphs and rune-like ornament. Gate feathers and plain architectural geometry only. No figures, faces, people, angels, statues, text, logos, frame or watermark. Keep it a wide establishing landscape, not a close-up.

jobs.title: 달빛 다리
jobs.note: v1의 다리를 아래로 내려 구름 수평선을 하단 1/3에 맞추고 주변 성을 비운 보완안.
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. EDIT reference 1 into stage_card_03-v3, opaque 16:9 painted pixel-art story landscape, largest available resolution. Reference 1 edit target, references 2 and 3 game style, reference 4 Alfheim palette/landmarks. Preserve the LONG horizontal moonlit arched bridge, exactly TWO glowing CIRCULAR moon gates at its two ends, and the large crescent in the upper left. Correct the high horizon and overcrowded edges: move the WHOLE BRIDGE DOWN so its deck lies exactly around y74% image height, both gates' centres at y61% and bases on that same deck. The bridge should span x28-72%, centred, and the two full circular gates at x29% and x71%. Cloud-sea horizon must be a clear low horizontal band at y75%. DELETE ALL high side mountains, tall side castles and multiple peripheral islands. Replace them with quiet open blue-violet night sky and a few low misty silhouettes ONLY below y76%. A few lilac trees can sit beside bridge ends, BELOW gate top height. Leave main landmarks wholly visible. Outer 3% calm and low contrast. Silver moonlight falls from upper-left crescent; lavender stone, navy-blue sky, controlled midtones, crisp painted pixel clusters matching game. No banners, signs, sigils, lettering, glyphs, runes, figures, faces, people, animals, UI, frame, border, watermark. This must be one wide scene, no layout annotations.

jobs.title: 불의 짐승
jobs.note: v1의 마름모 표식을 제거하고 주변 산·성 밀도를 줄인 보완안. 짐승은 눈·엄니만 연기 속에 둔다.
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. EDIT reference 1 into stage_card_07-v3, one opaque wide 16:9 painted pixel-art landscape at largest available resolution. Reference 1 edit target, references 2 and 3 game's pixel painting style, reference 4 Muspelheim palette/fortress. Preserve the central LAVA FORTRESS, exactly TWO strong vertical lava ERUPTION PILLARS flanking it, and the subtle beast hint of TWO ember eyes and TWO partial curved tusks half hidden by smoke below the castle. No full beast, no head contour, snout, mouth, body or legs. Fix the forbidden diamond-like emblem: REMOVE the bright diamond on the tower entirely, replace with plain dark unmarked basalt; no shape, window or rune in its place. Correct clutter and horizon: eliminate tall background mountains and peripheral castles, leaving quiet layered burgundy smoke sky, a CLEAR low terrain horizon around y74%, fortress grounded at y73%, tall central spire at y27%. Keep eruption tips at y30%, no explosions at edges. Reduce the broad orange sky glare to a smaller soft warm opening in upper LEFT, lights left fortress planes; shadow midtones muted charcoal-burgundy, controlled orange highlights. Make the four beast features small and partly veiled rather than a prominent angry face; smoke has no animal-shaped outline. The outer 8px must be quiet charcoal or burgundy scenery. No text, glyphs, numerals, geometric emblems, logos, people, figures, UI, border, frame or watermark.
